boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented Jefferson study and gathering spaces across the Center City and East Falls campuses.

cards.title: Scott Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Center City Campus · 1020 Walnut Street
cards.notes: Use the library as a starting point for an individual work session, then choose a quiet floor or reserve a room that fits your group.
cards.short_summary: A four-floor Center City library with study, learning, and collection-access spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson says Scott Memorial Library provides space and technology resources, with spaces and computers for study and learning across four floors.
cards.access_notes: Located on Jefferson’s Center City Campus; follow library and campus access requirements.

cards.entity_name: Scott Memorial Library Second-Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Scott’s group study rooms
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City Campus
cards.notes: Reserve a second-floor room when your group needs a monitor, whiteboard, and power; arrive ready to end the session when the next booking begins.
cards.short_summary: Ten reservable group rooms equipped for shared academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists ten second-floor group study rooms for Jefferson students, with monitors, whiteboards, and power outlets.
cards.source_title: Scott Memorial Library | Student Study Spaces
cards.access_notes: Jefferson students only; reserve up to seven days ahead for up to four hours per day.

cards.entity_name: Scott Memorial Library Third-Floor Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Scott’s individual study rooms
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City Campus
cards.notes: Book a third-floor room for focused solo work or a paired session, and collect the required key from Access Services before your reservation.
cards.short_summary: Six bookable individual rooms with desks, whiteboards, and power.
cards.evidence_claim: Scott Memorial Library has six third-floor individual study rooms equipped with whiteboards, desks, and power outlets.
cards.source_title: Scott Memorial Library | Student Study Spaces
cards.access_notes: Jefferson students only; reservations are limited to four hours daily and require a key from Access Services.

cards.entity_name: Scott Memorial Library Fourth-Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Scott’s fourth-floor quiet study
cards.subtitle: Scott Memorial Library · Center City Campus
cards.notes: Choose this floor when you need a quieter stretch of reading or review time; use the stairs while elevator service remains unavailable.
cards.short_summary: A reopened quiet-study floor at Scott Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson announced that Scott Memorial Library’s fourth floor is open for quiet study.
cards.source_title: 4th Floor Reopens at Scott Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: The published notice directs users to access the floor via stairs while elevator service is restored.

cards.title: Paul J. Gutman Library
cards.subtitle: East Falls Campus · 4201 Henry Avenue
cards.notes: Stop in for a quiet floor, group room, or librarian research help, and use the library’s East Falls location as a dependable study base.
cards.short_summary: The East Falls campus library offers quiet floors, group rooms, and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson identifies Gutman Library as the East Falls campus library and directs visitors there for group study rooms, quiet floors, and librarian assistance.
cards.access_notes: Located on the East Falls Campus; consult the library’s reservation page for room eligibility.

cards.title: Gutman Study Room 101
cards.subtitle: Paul J. Gutman Library · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Reserve Room 101 for a larger project group when a shared display helps; make one four-hour booking and avoid consecutive room reservations.
cards.short_summary: A reservable 6–8 person study room with a plasma screen.
cards.evidence_claim: Gutman Library lists Study Room 101 as a 6–8 person reservable room with a plasma screen for computer projection.
cards.source_title: Paul J. Gutman Library | Reserving Space
cards.access_notes: Current students, faculty, and staff reserve with a Jefferson-issued email; one active four-hour reservation per patron.

cards.title: Rena Rowan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Paul J. Gutman Library · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Book this room for a large-group study session when it is not needed for tutoring or instruction, and plan around its limited technology setup.
cards.short_summary: A bookable, up-to-20-person reading room that students may use for large-group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Gutman Library says students may book the Rena Rowan Reading Room for large-group study; it seats up to 20 people.
cards.source_title: Paul J. Gutman Library | Reserving Space
cards.access_notes: Primarily used for tutoring or instruction; students may book it for up to five hours. No technology or power outlets are listed.

cards.title: Kanbar Campus Center
cards.subtitle: East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Meet classmates in the shared seating areas or use the building’s student-facing services between classes; check the center’s posted schedule before going.
cards.short_summary: East Falls’ campus center combines meeting areas, dining, recreation, and Student Life offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson describes Kanbar Campus Center as an East Falls hub with meeting areas, a café/recreation area, dining, and Student Life offices.
cards.access_notes: Posted regular building hours are Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–midnight and weekends noon–midnight.

cards.entity_name: Jefferson Alumni Hall Northwest Student Lounge
cards.title: Northwest Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Alumni Hall · Center City Campus
cards.notes: Use the Northwest Student Lounge as an open student work break between classes, and leave enough time to exit before the listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: An open student lounge in Jefferson Alumni Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s study-space guide lists the Northwest Student Lounge in Jefferson Alumni Hall as open student space.
cards.access_notes: The guide lists this lounge as open 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; students using open study space must show Jefferson ID and may be asked to sign in.

cards.title: Curtis second-floor lobby
cards.subtitle: Curtis Building · Center City Campus
cards.notes: Set up in the second-floor lobby for an open study session, keeping your Jefferson ID available and following any security-desk sign-in instructions.
cards.short_summary: A designated open student space in the Curtis Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson designates the Curtis Building’s Second Floor Lobby as open student space.
cards.access_notes: The guide lists the lobby as open 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; students using open study space must show Jefferson ID and may be asked to sign in.
